name: D09_2_mana_value_6_counts_5_does_not
notes: Printed: '... a creature card with mana value 6 or greater ...'. My library holds a mana value 5 creature (on top) and a mana value 6 creature. I take the may and take the default pick: the mana value 5 creature is not a candidate, so the one candidate, the mana value 6 creature, goes to my hand (6 is '6 or greater'); the mana value 5 one stays in the library.
